sources.observation: The east palace stands on a stone terrace that follows the cliff. Paired corner turrets frame broad glazed upper galleries. The square Caballero Alto rises above the garden and tiled roofs. Two shallow white vaults cover the western museum wings.

limitations: The terrain uses the public Terrarium grid. Individual rail bays, slope transitions, roof equipment and garden ornament are reconstructed from the aerial exterior. Independently mapped outbuildings remain native map features.
